@adamant064 The snapshot fallback gap is present, but the CPU-initialization explanation is still a hypothesis. For one failed snap, please report only the hexadecimal HRESULT from the local camera.snap failure line and whether “MediaCapture initialized” and “CapturePhotoToStreamAsync completed” appeared for that attempt. Can the lock’s recorded starttime be compared with the actual start time and executable type of that PID, and can you identify the installed Gateway package version? This is not fixed. Your November 9 confirmation on Companion/CLI 2026.11.1 remains important evidence: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1975#issuecomment-6730900436. Keeping #1701 open for native browser-port attestation and status/profiles proof, including rejection of foreign/replaced listeners. No ownership checks should be disabled.
